title: Privacy-Focused AI Assistant Ollie is Shutting Down
excerpt: Ollie, an AI assistant known for its focus on user privacy, is closing its doors in just one week amid a crowded market.
body_html:
The privacy-focused artificial intelligence assistant Ollie is closing down. According to its founder, the service will cease operations in one week.

The closure comes at a time when the market is seeing a rising number of competing AI assistants. Ollie had distinguished itself by prioritizing user privacy in its operations before making the decision to shut down.
